name: Redragon H540-PRO LUNA Quad Mode Wireless Gaming Headset
shortDescription: Redragon H540 Pro Luna Quad Mode Wireless Gaming Headset Black (Quad-Mode Connectivity: 2.4GHz Wireless / Bluetooth / 3.5mm Wired / USB Wired / 53mm Neodymium Drivers / Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound / Detachable Noise-Cance
descriptionHtml:
Redragon H540 Pro Luna Quad Mode Wireless Gaming Headset Black (Quad-Mode Connectivity: 2.4GHz Wireless / Bluetooth / 3.5mm Wired / USB Wired / 53mm Neodymium Drivers / Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound / Detachable Noise-Canceling Microphone / Cooled Ice-Silk Memory Foam Ear Cushions / 600mAh Battery Up to 30 Hours / 1 Year Official Local Agent Warranty)

Experience total audio versatility with the Redragon H540 Pro Luna Quad Mode wireless gaming headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty. Engineered with ultimate Quad-Mode connectivity, this headset seamlessly operates via ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, 3.5mm wired, or USB wired connections for maximum device flexibility. Powered by large 53mm Neodymium drivers delivering Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound and an extended frequency range from 15Hz to 30kHz, it offers rich spatial precision. Designed for extended marathon sessions, it features lightweight steel-reinforced construction (263g), breathable cooled ice-silk fabric memory foam ear cushions, a detachable noise-canceling boom mic, and a long-lasting 600mAh battery providing up to 30 hours of continuous playback.
